messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front and moves through a side view toward the rear over a 120-degree arc. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front and moves through a side view toward the rear over a 120-degree arc. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, turning her body to show different angles while occasionally raising her arms to touch her hair or pose with hands on her hips.","camera":"The camera maintains a full-body shot, orbiting around the character to capture her from the side, back, and front.","clothing":"She wears a short, form-fitting dress with a white background and a colorful floral pattern, along with pink slip-on sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright red.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and tanned skin.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor European-style street with cobblestone paving, brick buildings, and a Union Jack flag hanging on a building in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output remains a full-body shot of the same red-haired character in the same floral dress and pink shoes, but the background changes from the original brick street with Union Jack and shop signs to a different European-style building facade and street. The camera appears to move around the character, showing side, back, and front views, though the starting framing does not clearly match the provided reference.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a full-body orbit starting in front, moving through side toward the rear over a 120-degree arc, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing; preserve the person, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the orbit covered exactly a 120-degree arc.
Whether the action timing and progression were preserved exactly relative to the source.
unexpected_changes: The scene/background was changed to a different street and building facade instead of preserving the existing scene.
The initial camera framing and subject placement do not clearly match the provided reference image.
